findings: In the release actual-main DijkstraLarge<true,false,true>, the outer binary-heap loop calls the outlined std::priority_queue<...,std::greater<pair>>::pop at0x408cd0. The helper has523bytes. Queue state/current key are stored around the call and reloaded afterwards.

The candidate actual-main DijkstraLarge contains no priority_queue pop/emplace call. The pop sift is embedded in the parent body, including the size>1 branch from0x408a83 to0x408ea0. This confirms different inlining in actual-main code, independently of the BOTH-API harness.

The release emplace<long&,int&> helper call at0x408c8c is the initial source enqueue. Successful edge-relaxation insertion is already inline in the release parent; do not describe each push as an outlined call.

This assembly difference does not establish that it caused the online regression or yields an actual-main speedup. Parent reports equal-main AL02 medians release46.743ms,candidate47.048ms,old47.052ms (approximately flat); BOTH-API body−26.37% must remain a separately compiled measurement.

import json,heapq,collections

 with (root/(name+'.in')).open()as f:
  n,m,s,t=map(int,f.readline().split());g=[[]for _ in range(n)]
  for line in f:
   u,v,w=map(int,line.split());g[u].append((v,w))
 seen={s};v=s;dist=0;target=t==s;prefix=0
 while len(g[v])==1:
  to,w=g[v][0]
  if to in seen:break
  seen.add(to);prefix+=1;dist+=w;v=to;target|=v==t
 # Independent heap reference and path length, no library timing.

   z=d+w

    ds[vv]=z;ps[vv]=u;heapq.heappush(q,(z,vv));updates+=1
    if len(q)>=65 and first65 is None:first65=updates
  maxq=max(maxq,len(q))
